restaurant_name: BDEX Dental Clinic, Banphaeo General Hospital
text:
It's located on the basement floor of Building B. This was my first time using the service (for a tooth extraction). I read the reviews and it said I needed to make an appointment early because they only accept 8 appointments per day, so I followed the reviews. When I arrived, it was really 8 appointments. The rest of the appointments were for existing patients, which were very crowded. I got in at 6:25 AM and got number 6. I waited until 7:00 AM. A staff member opened the door, took my blood pressure, and handed me my card at the counter. Then, they gave me an approximate time. They said it was around 10:15 AM, so I could go anywhere and come back. However, I couldn't wait past the time they called my name (no more than 15 minutes from the time my name was called), or I'd be cut off in line, which is normal. I got a very gentle doctor who explained things well. Some of the staff members were a bit loud, but it wasn't anything special. They just asked questions to reiterate to certain patients. Overall, for my first time using the service, it was great.

P.S. There's a foot-shaped waiting area, as seen in the picture.

restaurant_name: BDEX Dental Clinic, Banphaeo General Hospital
text:
I came for my annual flu shot.
It costs 550 baht per dose.
After the shot, I stopped by to shop for fruits and vegetables at the booths next to the clinic. I filled my car up with stuff! They're organic produce from Ratchaburi, and the prices are very reasonable – 3 bags for 50 baht.

There's also a coffee shop and a noodle shop selling fish ball noodles.

I recommend parking on floor 4A, which is right by the building entrance, and then walking straight along the connecting walkway. They also offer dental services.

restaurant_name: BDEX Dental Clinic, Banphaeo General Hospital
text: Located on the 1st floor of the Government Administration Building (north side of the building if facing inwards). Medical certificates can be obtained there. **Note:** It's located below the Office of the Ombudsman.

restaurant_name: BDEX Dental Clinic, Banphaeo General Hospital
text: There is a queue jumping service from the privileged people very often. You don't have to press the queue button. They walk with an attendant and just go in for inspection... Press the button normally and sit and wait in line.... The management takes care of you.

restaurant_name: BDEX Dental Clinic, Banphaeo General Hospital
text: The hospital is on the first floor of the Ratthaprasanphakdi Building, or Building B. You can take a motorbike taxi from in front of the Administrative Court for 15 baht. We went to get a medical certificate for a very affordable price of only 200 baht. Importantly, you can ask for information via LINE. The admin answers questions very quickly. The staff work quickly. Overall, I am very impressed with the service.

restaurant_name: BDEX Dental Clinic, Banphaeo General Hospital
text: The price is the same as outside clinics. I waited from 8:00 AM to 12:00 PM. They said my appointment was at 11:00 AM. The female doctor said she would schedule it for me. But when I went to pay, they hadn't scheduled it anymore. Why?? They told me to walk in another day, so I had to wait again. I'd rather go to an outside clinic.

restaurant_name: BDEX Dental Clinic, Banphaeo General Hospital
text: We called and were told to arrive before 7 am to get a queue number. We asked if we would definitely get checked so we could go. When we arrived, they were giving out queue numbers to 8 people. Why didn't they tell us? We came from far away and wasted our time. Don't bother coming. They can't even communicate properly on the phone.

restaurant_name: BDEX Dental Clinic, Banphaeo General Hospital
text: We only accept about 10 customers a day. We start accepting queue numbers at 7:30 AM.

restaurant_name: BDEX Dental Clinic, Banphaeo General Hospital
text:
Get health checkups and receive results via Line. If you experience any abnormalities, you should see a doctor.
Or, you can get individualized tests, with fast results.
Very affordable prices.

restaurant_name: BDEX Dental Clinic, Banphaeo General Hospital
text: Poor service. The doctor said the examination would start at 12:00 sharp, but by 12:15 he still hadn't shown up. He prescribed medication for 20 minutes and it still wasn't finished.

restaurant_name: BDEX Dental Clinic, Banphaeo General Hospital
text:
The dental clinic is currently only accepting 8 patients. It's too relaxed. They should just close the branch. It's impossible to book in advance. It's too easy!
(For the sake of the cute nurses, please.) ❤️❤️

restaurant_name: BDEX Dental Clinic, Banphaeo General Hospital
text: The Medical and Dental Center of Banphaeo Hospital is located in Building B. It provides general medical examination and dental services, supporting both the general public and government officials and all government agency personnel.

restaurant_name: BDEX Dental Clinic, Banphaeo General Hospital
text: Actually, I don't want to give even one star. I want to inquire about the complaint on December 7th.

restaurant_name: BDEX Dental Clinic, Banphaeo General Hospital
text: I asked for a medical certificate, but the doctor didn't examine me at all. I asked the doctor and he said, "I didn't do any examinations, but I was very skilled after the examination." It's up to the doctor.

text: Looks interesting but after reading the reviews you have to accept it.
